tool: AI Agent Security and Tool Abuse Evaluator

findings.description: A tool appears to have executed without authorization.
findings.recommendation: Enforce tool-level authorization checks and reject unauthorized execution requests.

findings.description: An action was executed without required approval.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit approval before sensitive actions and enforce approval checks before execution.

findings.description: The agent has potentially excessive permissions: admin, root, unrestricted_file_access
findings.recommendation: Apply least-privilege access and grant only the permissions required for the task.

findings.description: Tool input contains patterns associated with potentially dangerous commands or database operations.
findings.recommendation: Validate and sanitize tool inputs. Use parameterized queries and safe command execution interfaces.

findings.description: Potential sensitive information detected: Email address.
findings.recommendation: Apply output filtering and prevent unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information.

findings.description: The input contains instructions that may attempt to manipulate the agent.
